headline: West Texas A&M concede ten in two matches
dek: West Texas A&M opened with four goals and a clean sheet against Adams State, and have since lost at home to Fort Lewis and away at Colorado Christian without scoring. Only Sul Ross State, beaten in both their matches, have let in as many.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Seven different players have scored Midwestern State's eleven goals, and Jose Ortiz has four of them.

wire.line: Oklahoma Christian have won both their matches and have not conceded a goal.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: All three of the season's score gaps are Lubbock Christian's: each match is marked final and carries no published score. Two more matches are past their date with no result at all, a separate absence and a separate count.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Every match with a published score now has a box score behind it: the count of box score gaps stands at zero, and it is a separate count from the score gaps and the matches past their date with no result.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Tyler have played once and won it without conceding, and Dennis Nyame's goal is the only one the programme has scored.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Fernando Hernandez has made eighteen saves for Sul Ross State and has yet to keep a clean sheet.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Kaleo Perez-Francis has made six saves for St. Edward's and been beaten once.

last_match.line: West Texas A&M have not scored since their opening match; Colorado Christian had already lost to a Lone Star side this season, at Oklahoma Christian.

next_match.line: UT Dallas are unbeaten but have yet to play away from home; this opens a run of away matches.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
